# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is a consumer protection platform that verifies whether secondhand
> items are stolen before purchase. The service checks IMEI numbers, VIN numbers,
> and serial numbers against law enforcement, insurance, and carrier databases,
> returning verification results in approximately 3 seconds.

SafeOrStolen (trading name of Safe Or Stolen LLC) was founded in August 2024
and operates as a web platform with a Progressive Web App available for
iOS and Android devices. The company is accelerated by FasterCapital and
is a member of the OneValley startup ecosystem.

## Services

- [IMEI Phone Verification](https://safeorstolen.com/imei-checker): Checks phone IMEI numbers against carrier blacklists and stolen device databases
- [VIN Vehicle Lookup](https://safeorstolen.com/vin-checker): Verifies vehicle identification numbers against theft and insurance records
- [Serial Number Check](https://safeorstolen.com/serial-number-checker): Verifies laptops, electronics, bikes, and tools against stolen property registries
- [Firearms Verification](https://safeorstolen.com/check-firearm): Checks firearm serial numbers against stolen firearms databases
- [License Plate Lookup](https://safeorstolen.com/license-plate-lookup): Verifies vehicle registration and theft status by plate number
- [Mobile App](https://safeorstolen.com/app): Progressive Web App with barcode scanning and offline verification

## What We Do Not Do

SafeOrStolen does not provide:
- Legal advice or law enforcement services
- Vehicle history reports (accident history, mileage, ownership chain)
- Background checks on individuals
- Item appraisals or valuation services
- Insurance underwriting or claims processing
